    "input": {

        "ORD-0000-01",

        "ORD-0000-07",
        "ORD-0000-08",
        "ORD-0000-09"

    },
    "output": {
      "shape": {
        "code": "orphan_payment|orphan_refund",
        "event_id": "string",
        "source_rows": "one-element string array"
      }
    },
    "examples": []
  }
}

You are authorized to submit the result to the local TaskForge service. Create payload.json with the following envelope (replace the example with the actual result; artifact file paths are relative to the project, without materials/ or reference_work/ prefixes):
{"task_id": "classify-p0000-12", "artifact": {"kind": "json", "value": "your result"}}
